critique: Rising motion confirmed (t1: particles confined to lower half; t4: filled frame — oldest particles reached top). Background near-black warm: good. Density: individual embers readable, acceptable. TWO failures: (1) particles are too dim and small — they read as faint dust motes or distant fireflies, not HOT embers; cores need to feel luminous (brighter amber, stronger glow, slightly larger). (2) rightward wind drift is not readable comparing t1→t4 — the cloud envelope looks horizontally symmetric; the oldest (topmost) particles should visibly lean right. Note: true ember fade-out (size/opacity over life) is a CUSTOM_VALUE curve — unscriptable, would need a .ffx preset; not blocking pass.
